SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Where oh where did Yuman’s ID run off to…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 呜呜～宥万的身份证跑去哪儿了嘛～
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 呼…宥萬的身分證在哪裡呢…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ふぅん、ユマンの身分証どこいっちゃったのかなぁ〜
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Onde será que a identidade do Yuman foi parar…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿A dónde habrá ido el ID de Yumaaaaan...?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوخییی... کارت ملی یومان جونم کجا قایم شده یعنی...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Did it just grow little legs and poof disappear…?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 它会不会长了小脚丫，“嗖！”一下飞走啦～
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 難道它長腳，咻一下就不見了嗎…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 足が生えてピョン！って消えちゃったのかな〜…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa jangan-jangan tadi lari kenceng banget terus pyong! hilang gitu ya...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Será que criou perninha e puff, sumiu…?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نکنه پا درآورده جیم زده رفته بیرون...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What exactly are you doing right now?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que exatamente você tá fazendo agora?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: الان دقیقاً دارین چیکار می‌کنین با این اداتون؟

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 身分証、早く出してください
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por favor, me entregue sua identidade.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But Yuman really, really wants some beer…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 可是宥万现在好想好想喝啤酒嘛…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 可是宥萬很想喝啤酒耶…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもユマンはビールが飲みたいのにぃ〜…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi Yuman tuh lagi pengin banget minum beer...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas o Yuman quer muuuito uma cerveja…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آخه یومانی کوچولو خیلی خیلی دلش نوشیدنی خنک می‌خواد...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 안 사가면 안 된당~ 말숙이가 퍽퍽! 때릴게 분명행...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If I don’t buy it, Mal-sook will totally smack me around~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不买回去的话，末淑一定会啪啪打我的啦…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不買的話不行啦～末淑一定會打人家…咚咚咚！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 買って帰らないとマルスクにボコッ！て殴られちゃうんだもん…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau nggak dibeliin, Mal-sook pasti bug bug! marah-marah ke aku...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se eu não comprar, a Mal-sook vai me bater de verdade~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si no la llevo, Mal-sook seguro me va a dar tas tas…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگه نخرم ببرم، مال‌سوک وحشی مثل چی کتکم می‌زنه...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait wait wait, hold on, hold on!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊？？？等、等一下等一下等一下！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 咦？？？等一下，等一下，等一下！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あっ！？ ちょ、ちょっと待って！待って待って！
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چییی؟! صبر کنین صبر کنین، گوشی رو بذارین!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Okay, okay, I get it—just a second!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我知道了我知道了！拜托等等！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我知道了，我知道了。啊等一下
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: わかった！わかったから！ちょっと待ってください！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá bom, tá bom, eu entendi—só um segundo!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فهمیدم، غلط کردم! یه لحظه دست نگه دارین!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Without an ID, I can’t sell this to you.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 没有身份证，我们无法出售商品
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 沒有身分證的話，我們不能賣
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 身分証がない場合は販売できません
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tanpa KTP, penjualan nggak bisa dilakukan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sem identidade, eu não posso vender isso pra você.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بدون کارت ملی امکان فروش ندارم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, I just helped you out earlier…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我刚才不是还帮你解围了吗…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哎唷，我剛才才幫你解圍的啊…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、さっき助けてあげたじゃないですか〜…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aduh, aku kan barusan udah nolongin kamu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, eu acabei de te ajudar antes…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Ay, pero si la ayudé hace un rato…!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بابا من همین الان کمکتون کردم اخه...

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Só dessa vez, vai? Por favor?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فقط همین یه بار! باشه؟ خواهش می‌کنم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Please come back with your ID.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 麻煩您帶著身分證再來一趟
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 身分証をご持参のうえ、再度ご来店ください
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tolong bawa KTP dan datang lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por favor, volte com sua identidade.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Por favor, vuelva con su identificación.
